narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video document a humorous and casual experience of the creator trying a traditional medicated oil (Siang Pure Oil) for the first time. Initially skeptical about its strong scent, she later discovers its soothing cooling effect on her neck and retracts her plan to give it away, using the anecdote to jokingly reflect on her own reliability. The video ends with a promotional bumper for a dermatology clinic.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator prominently features and uses Siang Pure Oil (上標油), and the video concludes with detailed contact information and branding for DRX Dermatology Clinic.
